title: Squared-off object tumbles into the back pasture at the country house

tellings.quote: this object that was squared off came tumbling across the sky and went into the back pasture behind the house.

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer known for his books about meeting strange beings, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about something from his childhood in Texas in the 1950s. He says that at his family's country house, an object with squared-off edges came tumbling across the sky and fell into the back pasture behind the house, and he names a relative, Karl Strieber, in the story. If true, it would mean his strange experiences began with a crash he saw as a boy.
